name: Marino Pallenberg
original_name: マリノ・パレンバーグ
source: Masayuki's younger sister-in-law. Half German, half Japanese. German art dealer Ralf Pallenberg's only daughter. Pallenberg died last spring, she now lives together with Masayuki's mother-in-law in Germany. She loves Masayuki as if he is her real brother.
